reviewer: host/native/build.lisp:318 and :365, and host/native/build-dtn.lisp:219 and :256, both ld host/page-read-host.lisp. The file holds only include-books, defuns and defthms. The build succeeds, so the second ld is all redundant events: wasted build time plus a latent ordering hazard, with no functional effect today.
scenario: The second ld re-reads a file of about 30 defuns and several defthms (fn-owner-incoming-*). Every event is redundant today, so it adds build time and nothing else. It also hides an edit hazard: if the first load is ever removed or reordered (the stage-0 comment at 358-364 shows these lists are being edited), the image silently depends on the later copy, whose position differs. tools/build_lists_check / host_check compare these lists as sets and do not flag a duplicate. The line at 365 looks like a leftover from replacing the account-adoption lds.
